proposal.summary: Stored cross-site scripting in Adive Framework 2.0.8 via the userUsername parameter enables an attacker to inject JavaScript that, when an administrator views the page, issues a POST to /admin/config to change the administrator password.
proposal.cwe_quote: The parameter 'userUsername=' is vulnerable to Stored Cross-site scripting

AC.quote: As soon as admin will visit the page the payload will be triggered and the admin password will be changed to hacked@123

proposal.recommended_next_step: Reproduce the issue by submitting a stored XSS payload in userUsername, confirm admin-facing execution and the POST to /admin/config, then immediately mitigate by removing the stored malicious entry and add server-side input validation/encoding for userUsername and CSRF protections on sensitive config endpoints.
